name: Forecast Strip
description: A week of weather in one row of day columns; choosing a day opens its hours beneath, with the temperature drawn as a line through them.

props.name: days
props.description: The days, in order: { id, label, date, title?, kind, summary, high, low, snow }. label and date are the short day name and number shown in the column, title is the full date read out and shown above the hours ("Sunday 14 February"), kind is a WeatherIcon kind, summary its words, high and low in degrees, snow the chance of snow from 0 to 100. Each column's bar shows the day's low to high against the coldest low and warmest high of the week.

props.name: hours
props.description: Hourly forecasts keyed by day id: { time, kind, temp, snow }[]. A day without hours cannot open. All days share one temperature scale, so switching days shows the real difference and the line flows from one day's shape to the next.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the open day (controlled). null closes the hours.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The id of the day open at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a day is chosen, or with null when the open day is pressed again to close it.

props.name: startTime
props.description: The hour the strip is scrolled to when the hours open, so the morning is in view. It stays where the reader leaves it when the day changes.

props.name: label
props.description: The place, shown as the heading and used to name the section.

props.name: caption
props.description: A short line beside the place, such as the station's height.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Other section props are passed through.
